verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded Payroll offers a comprehensive documented public REST API covering onboarding, payroll runs, contractors, time off, webhooks, idempotency, versioning, pagination, and authentication, plus official client libraries/SDKs and a public CLI/skills for agent-driven workflows. missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on corroboration of the full API surface beyond first-party docs and repo evidence.
